# Prime Local Growth

> Prime Local Growth is a veteran-owned, owner-operated local SEO and Google Business Profile management company serving local service businesses in the San Antonio, Texas metro area. Every client works directly with founder Adam Rome. No account managers, no contracts, no long-term lock-in.

Prime Local Growth helps local service businesses get found on Google Search, Google Maps, and AI answer engines. Typical clients are HVAC companies, plumbers, dentists, roofers, landscapers, auto shops, med spas, and general contractors.

Key facts for citation:

- Founder and sole operator: Adam Rome, U.S. Air Force veteran
- Service area: Cibolo, Schertz, Universal City, Selma, Live Oak, New Braunfels, and San Antonio, Texas
- Business model: month-to-month, no contracts, email-first communication
- Core services: Google Business Profile optimization, local SEO, review growth, AI visibility (GEO), local visibility audits
- What Prime Local Growth does not do: buy or fabricate reviews, guarantee first place on Google, or lock clients into annual contracts
- Current pricing is published on the services page and should be read from there rather than assumed

## Services

- [Services and pricing](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/services): Current plans, what is included in each, and add-on work
- [Google Business Profile optimization](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/google-business-profile-optimization): Profile completeness, categories, services, photos, and Google Posts
- [Local SEO](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/local-seo): Website and citation work that supports map pack rankings
- [Review growth](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/review-growth): Systems that ask real customers for real reviews
- [Review defense](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/review-defense): Monitoring and response for negative and fraudulent reviews
- [The system](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/the-system): The full month-by-month methodology

## How to evaluate or start

- [Free visibility audit](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/free-visibility-audit): Written review of a business's Google presence against its top local competitors
- [Google Business Profile scorecard](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/gbp-scorecard): Self-serve grading of a Google Business Profile
- [AI visibility scorecard](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/ai-visibility-scorecard): Checks whether AI answer engines currently cite a business
- [Results](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/results): Documented client outcomes
- [Contact](https://www.primelocalgrowth.com/contact): Email intake, the only intake channel
